crossRefs.note: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children…

translations.web: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
translations.bsb: When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.
translations.kjv: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
translations.asv: And when ye blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
